roles.title: Technical Project Manager
roles.summary: Lead a 10–13 person team across client handling, development and delivery, while spending roughly 80% of my time hands-on in the code.
achievements: Built Linkyfy, an AI-driven LinkedIn outreach SaaS, from an empty repository to production in two months — now serving 150+ customers.
Delivered KiViP-Concierge, an AI agent service where models do the work and a human concierge reviews it, end-to-end including DevOps.
Own client communication, estimation and delivery planning, splitting time roughly 20% team leadership and 80% engineering.

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer
roles.summary: Built and scaled business platforms for European clients, from greenfield ERP systems to revenue-critical booking flows.
achievements: Built the AlphaTheta (Pioneer DJ) ERP, CRM and customer repair portal from scratch, now used by 2,000+ agents and distributors across Europe, Asia and the USA.
Delivered a booking platform for EasyStorage (part of easyGroup) that increased orders and became a profitable channel.
Contributed AI features and new modules to Veroxos, StableLogic's enterprise telecom and asset-management product.

roles.title: Lead Software Engineer
roles.summary: Worked across frontend and backend on microservice products in the auction, finance and ERP domains.
achievements: Developed microservices in Symfony and Node.js for a product serving ~800 customers and up to 2 million user visits at peak time.
Built an ERP system from scratch and took it live within six months; around 500 distinct user roles now run their operations on it across regions.
Shaped long-term architecture with clients, translating business goals into technical roadmaps.

roles.title: Software Developer (Team Lead)
roles.summary: Led microservice projects for government clients and fully automated event-ticketing systems.
achievements: Built microservice-based government platforms engineered to absorb heavy traffic peaks during events and festival seasons.
Automated event-ticket sales across TicketUtils and StubHub with scraping and data pipelines that ran reliably without manual work.
Owned server infrastructure and system architecture while coordinating developers and designers.

roles.title: Backend Developer
roles.summary: Owned the backend and infrastructure of an in-taxi advertising product, working directly with investors and management.
achievements: Built an ad-serving platform running in 1,000 taxis for 2,500 users and handling about 1 million requests per day.
Reached the product's business goals within 1.5 years, generating solid customer revenue.
Designed the system architecture and ran the server infrastructure; spent a month on-site in Bangkok to shape the roadmap.

roles.title: Technical Team Lead
roles.summary: Led web development for clients in diverse industries and backed mobile teams with APIs.
achievements: Assigned work, unblocked developers and built complex modules for client web projects.
Delivered backend APIs for mobile apps and handled backend deployment and app-store publishing.

roles.title: Software Developer (Team Lead)
roles.summary: Led the Indian development team for German client Goobing, with code review, TDD and BDD as standard practice.
achievements: Built dongK, a German e-commerce shop with live ticking prices, on AWS.
Developed modules for hannover.de, the official portal of the City and Region of Hannover, on eZ Platform (Symfony) with a large database.
Travelled to Germany for project and leadership meetings with teams from multiple countries.

roles.title: Software Developer (Team Lead)
roles.summary: Built and maintained client websites and in-house products across real estate, hosting and small business.
achievements: Ran a large Cayman Islands real-estate database powering 50+ real-estate websites for different companies.
Built in-house products that cut third-party server and email-marketing costs by up to 30%.
Delivered domain and hosting services built on WHMCS, plus R&D on complex project modules.
